$comment: Single source of truth for the voiceover and scene pacing. `text` is shown as captions; `say` is what the TTS reads (phonetic spellings). Scene length = max(min, lead + voice + tail). Edit, then run `pnpm assets:vo && pnpm assets:timeline && pnpm assets:bed`.

arrival.text: Hi, I'm Sudhanshu — a full-stack Gen-AI developer who obsesses over how things feel.
arrival.say: Hi, I'm Sudhaanshu. A full-stack Gen-AI developer, who obsesses over how things feel.

think.text: It starts with the problem, not the prompt — who it's for, and where AI actually helps.
think.say: It starts with the problem, not the prompt. Who it's for, and where AI actually helps.

design.text: Then I design the system, not just the screens. Type, spacing, motion — every pixel earns its place.

build.text: I build end to end — React and Next.js up front, typed APIs underneath.

intelligence.text: Then I make it think: RAG over your data, agents that use tools, answers that stream in real time.
